settings_colors_are_hex.name: settings_colors_are_hex
settings_colors_are_hex.value:
"settings"."color_background" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND "settings"."color_nav" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'
        AND "settings"."color_primary" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND "settings"."color_secondary" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'
        AND "settings"."color_accent" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND "settings"."color_danger" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'
        AND "settings"."color_text" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$'

product_variants_fixed_margin_required.name: product_variants_fixed_margin_required
product_variants_fixed_margin_required.value: "product_variants"."margin_mode" IS NULL OR "product_variants"."margin_mode" = 'pct' OR "product_variants"."margin_fixed_bs" IS NOT NULL

purchase_payments_source_matches.name: purchase_payments_source_matches
purchase_payments_source_matches.value:
("purchase_payments"."source" = 'account' AND "purchase_payments"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_payments"."partner_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("purchase_payments"."source" = 'partner' AND "purchase_payments"."partner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_payments"."account_id" IS NULL)

capital_movements_origin.name: capital_movements_origin
capital_movements_origin.value:
("capital_movements"."type" = 'contribution' AND ("capital_movements"."account_id" IS NOT NULL OR "capital_movements"."purchase_id" IS NOT NULL))
       OR ("capital_movements"."type" <> 'contribution' AND "capital_movements"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "capital_movements"."purchase_id" IS NULL)

money_movements_sign_matches_type.name: money_movements_sign_matches_type
money_movements_sign_matches_type.value:
CASE
        WHEN "money_movements"."type" IN ('sale', 'purchase_void', 'capital_in', 'expense_void') THEN "money_movements"."amount_bs" > 0
        WHEN "money_movements"."type" IN ('sale_void', 'purchase', 'capital_out', 'profit_out', 'expense') THEN "money_movements"."amount_bs" < 0
        ELSE TRUE
      END

stock_movements_sign_matches_type.name: stock_movements_sign_matches_type
stock_movements_sign_matches_type.value:
CASE
        WHEN "stock_movements"."type" IN ('initial', 'purchase', 'sale_void') THEN "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
        WHEN "stock_movements"."type" IN ('sale', 'purchase_void', 'expired', 'damaged', 'sample', 'supplier_return') THEN "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
        ELSE TRUE
      END
